title: All GTA 6 Animals And Wildlife Spawn Locations
summary:
You can go birdwatching in GTA 6. Seriously. You can put aside that life of crime and take up the rather harmless hobby of logging new birds. It's not just birds, as there are reptiles, mammals, and marine animals in every county of the state of Leonida. Some are exotic, others common, and even some non-native creatures that are just plain weird to see here.

Of course, you don't have to look for critters in GTA 6. Plenty of other side activities that aren't main missions are worth indulging in, such as finding all the WAiNK Sculptures and WAiNK landmarks, and reading all the magazines, books, and comics scattered throughout Leonida. You can even track down missing people if you've run out of animals to go hunting for.

How to log Wildlife sightings

There are three ways to log your sightings of each animal in GTA 6. The first is for any creature that is close to you. You can focus by holding L2/LT, then press and hold R1/RB to study that animal. Once you fill the circle, that creature will be logged in your wildlife sighting progression track, which you can look at by opening the sub-menu.

If you'd rather not get up close and personal with an alligator, or if you're trying to track the many bird species in Leonida, you can equip the binoculars from your weapon wheel. You can zoom in using the D-Pad, but you'll need to track that animal as you use the Study prompt. This is certainly easier said than done, particularly for small or fast birds, but you'll eventually get the hang of it.

Finally, for any fishing-related animal sightings, you need to catch them with a fishing rod. One of the early missions in Chapter 1 teaches you everything you need to know about catching fish. Essentially, you cast out the line, reel it back in slowly to tempt a fish to bite, then, once you have one on the hook, you tire it out by pulling on the line in the opposite direction. Once you're holding it, it will be added to your log.

How many of each animal are there?

Wildlife is split into several categories

  • Hunting - 61 species
  • Fishing - 35 species
  • Mammals - 18 species
  • Cats & Dogs - 34 species
  • Reptiles & Amphibians - 6 species
  • Birds - 60 species
  • Aquatic - 18 species
  • Other - 23 species

title: Where To Find The Haunted Lighthouse And Ghost Ship In GTA 6
summary:
The cities of Grand Theft Auto 6 are full of mysteries, many of which occur late at night. So, if you’re not planning on clubbing (or cuddling) with your partner, you might want to head out to explore the wider world. One area that’s worth visiting is the haunted lighthouse. If you manage to learn the truth about what happened, you could even spot a ghost ship in the distance.

In This Article
  • Haunted lighthouse location
  • The specters of the lighthouse
  • The ruins and the journal
  • The boat, the diving spot, and the Cursed Knife
  • The ghost ship

Haunted lighthouse location

The haunted lighthouse in GTA 6 is located in Little Hardin Island in Leonard County. It’s in the northeastern part of the map. The image below shows you where you can find this structure, as well as the areas/objects that you need to check out.

Note 1: You must go to the lighthouse past midnight. However, unlike most other paranormal mysteries in the game, you can do the succeeding tasks with your partner tagging along instead of just flying solo.

Note 2: You have to cross deep water to reach the island. You can look for boats along the beach, though they might be hard to spot. Alternatively, you can take a RydeMe to a marina and steal a vessel there.

The specters of the lighthouse

If you head to the Little Hardin Island lighthouse past midnight, a deep fog will blanket your surroundings. You’ll also hear two men arguing somewhere.

Go ahead and climb to the top of the lighthouse to see two ghosts who are fighting and pushing each other. This altercation causes one of the specters to fall off the edge.

Note: The St. Lucia Lighthouse is actually a WAiNK Landmark. Be sure to scan it to add it to your collectibles tally.

The ruins and the journal

Carefully go back down the ladder. Once you’re on solid ground again, look at the bottom of the steps and pick up the photograph of the two men: Godfrey and Frank. Flip it over to learn more about the two.

Next, head to the northwestern part of the island, where there is a ruined building. It seems to be the residence of the two men when they were still alive.

Enter the building and turn to the right. As you approach the fireplace, a journal will fall down. Read it to ascertain the truth about what happened to the lighthouse’s caretakers.

The boat, the diving spot, and the Cursed Knife

The journal tells of the madness that befell the men. Before heading off, go to the northern tip of the island to spot a docked boat. Grab the Scuba Gear and sail on that boat (or just go back to the one that you used earlier).

Clues from the journal state that there’s gentle wind blowing from the east, but later on, a dark fog rolled in, followed by a terrible storm. From the dock, sail your boat to the east of the lighthouse just past the jutting isthmus.

If you’re at the correct spot, the boat will suddenly stop, and you won’t be able to control it. The deep fog will blanket the area again, as waves continue to rise. Grab the Scuba Gear and bring out the Metal Detector. Aim it at your surroundings until you see green flashes. Then, keep going in that direction until you see a wooden boat at the bottom of the sea.

Look closely at the skeleton and pick up the Cursed Knife. Next, quickly resurface, hop back on your boat, and sail back to the island once more. The storm’s intensity will likely increase at this stage, leading to zero visibility. Make sure you double-check the map to see if you’re heading in the right direction.

The ghost ship

Now that you have the Cursed Knife, it’s time to climb the ladder again, all the way to the top of the lighthouse. The specters will disappear, but you’ll be notified that there’s something odd in the distance.

If you look to the northeast, you’ll see the ghost ship. Quickly take out your binoculars to have a clearer view of it before it disappears completely.

The haunted lighthouse and ghost ship in GTA 6 are just an intricate mystery that continues to baffle the people of Leonida. There are other strange happenings in the game, which you can read about in our paranormal mysteries hub.

Examples include hapless folks being abducted by UFOs and a serial killer who targets tourists. Lastly, if you want to visit another creepy lighthouse, you should solve the perplexing puzzles in the Tenebrae Lux video game.

You’re going to feel lost as you explore the cities, beachfronts, and seedy underbelly of Leonida. If you need more help navigating the massive game world and tackling its activities, be sure to check our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

title: How To Find The Truffade Thrax In GTA 6
summary:
The Truffade Thrax is the fastest stock car in all of Grand Theft Auto 6. While other upgraded cars can reach a higher speed rating, the Thrax remains arguably the best car you can obtain during your entire playthrough. While there is technically a Truffade Thrax you can acquire near the end of the main story, that car can never be registered as yours.

So, if you want a Thrax that you can actually own, you'll have to do a bit of searching. However, you could also go the opposite way and complete Randy's Wish List in GTA 6, which concludes by bringing him the coveted Truffade Thrax. Whichever way you decide to go, you can see exactly where to find this ultra-rare vehicle in the guide below.

In This Article
  • Truffade Thrax location in GTA 6
    • Truffade Thrax for Randy's Wish List
    • Andrew Node's Truffade Thrax

Truffade Thrax location in GTA 6

There are two guaranteed Truffade Thrax locations on the map in GTA 6. While there's also a third Thrax that can spawn near Boone Speedway, this requires some RNG, so we won't be covering that until a foolproof method of acquiring it is found.

For the two guaranteed Thrax locations, you'll have to be patient and do a bit of sleuthing. We should also mention that one Thrax is meant for Randy's Wish List, while the other is yours if you can pay the large registration fee for it. We'll cover both of the Thraxes below so you can complete Randy's Wish List and walk away with a Thrax of your own in GTA 6.

Truffade Thrax for Randy's Wish List

We'll start with the Truffade Thrax that Randy wants for his wish list, as that's likely where you'll hear of the car for the first time in GTA 6. After you find the Mamba GT for Randy, you'll have to wait for a call to find out where to go for the Truffade Thrax. It's imperative you wait for Randy's call, as going before that results in the Thrax not being there.

Randy's Thrax is located on Dalton Island, which is a resort-style island located in southeast Vice-Dale County. In order to get there without a boat, you have to take a ferry from the south port on Waxman Island (costs $50). After arriving on Dalton Island, remember where the ferry is docked, as you'll need to get back on it to return to the mainland with the Thrax.

On Dalton Island, you can steal a nearby golf cart and head to the south part of the island. Specifically, you're trying to find the Dalton Island Club.

Here, all you have to do is head to the western valet parking lot, knock out or kill the security guard near the parked, dark green Thrax, then drive away back to where the ferry is docked. Hop on the ferry, pay the $50, and then head to Randy's garage in Balsero to deliver the Thrax to him.

Andrew Node's Truffade Thrax

In addition to Randy's Thrax, there's another one you can drive away with for free and register as your own car in GTA 6. However, this Thrax requires a glitch or some major legwork to acquire.

First, you can get this Truffade Thrax, which is labeled as Andrew Node's Thrax, by glitching into a garage on Starfish Island. This is an unintended way to get the Thrax, but the glitch is simple enough to do and doesn't break the game in any major way. To do it, follow these steps:

  • Go to Starfish Island and head to the long house that's found just beneath the "Island" text on the map. It's located on the south side of the main oval road.
  • With your car, reverse to the house's garage by pointing your back bumper at the garage door. However, leave a tiny gap between the car and the garage door.
  • Get out of the car and position yourself right in the gap.
  • Press the crouch and open phone buttons at the same time.
  • Continue to do this and adjust your position until you clip inside the garage.
  • Here, you'll find a blue Truffade Thrax that you can drive for free without worrying about any trackers.

If you don't want to do any kind of glitch, there's an intended way to get the Truffade Thrax. During Chapter 3 of GTA 6, you'll receive a text from Cal about his "No Flusher" group. Once you get this text, you can begin to WAiNK manhole covers with a blue toilet spray paint icon on them. You need to find 10 of these, and once you do, you can open a warehouse in Ocean Beach using the code: 8554013. We won't go through all 10 locations for the No Flusher tags, but this YouTube video showcases them perfectly.

In this warehouse, you can search through a laptop, which gives you Andrew Node's address. The address is located on Starfish Island, and by visiting the mansion, you can open the garage and drive away in Andrew Node's blue Truffade Thrax.

It costs a whopping $70K to register the Thrax, though, so you might need a garage to store the car in before you save up enough for its fee in GTA 6. Either way, you now have one of the best and fastest cars in the entire game.

There’s so much more to learn and do in Leonida, so be sure to use our GTA 6 guides hub.

title: Call Of Duty’s 19-Year Sales Streak Continues
summary:
Circana has released its latest monthly sales report for the US video game industry, and in terms of game sales, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 led the way.

It was the No. 1 best-selling game of October 2026, and that's notable because it marked the 19th consecutive year that a new Call of Duty game has been the top-selling title for its launch month.

This streak began in November 2008 when Call of Duty: World at War beat out Guitar Hero: World Tour and Gears of War 2 to rank No. 1.

Circana also announced that spending on content for consoles dropped by 18% compared to October 2026. It was always going to be a tough comparison, though, as October 2025 saw the releases of Battlefield 6 and Pokemon Legends Z-A.

Looking ahead to November 2026, Rockstar's GTA 6 is no doubt going to rank No. 1 for the month and it's sure to finish 2026 as the best-selling game overall. It's already selling at a blistering pace, after all.

October 2026 top 10 best-selling games in the US

  1. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4*
  2. Gears of War: E-Day*
  3. Star Wars: Galactic Racer*
  4. EA Sports FC 27*
  5. NBA 2K27^
  6. Final Fantasy Resonance^
  7. Madden NFL 27*
  8. Control: Resonant*
  9. Kingdom Hearts Collection I - III^
  10. Nintendo Switch Sports Resort*

*Includes digital sales projections

^Includes digital point of sale actuals

title: All Race Challenges & Racetrack Locations In GTA 6
summary:
For the first time in the Grand Theft Auto franchise, Rockstar Games has created actual racetracks for players to race on in GTA 6. While you can still compete in street races through the roads and alleys of Vice City and other parts of the map, there are also dedicated speedways for you to truly test your racing skills.

Like most side activities in GTA 6, though, you're not given the location of these racetracks or the race challenges that come with them. So, if you want to partake in some of the best racing the GTA franchise has to offer, take a look below to see the location of every racetrack and its challenge in GTA 6.

    • Gellhorn Raceway
    • Thrillbilly Mud Club
    • Boone Speedway
    • Ambrosia Raceway
    • Waning Sands
    • Hamlet
    • Mount Kalaga

All racetrack locations in GTA 6

Around Leonida, there are seven racetracks that you can race at, and each of these racetracks offers a different set of race challenges. A majority of the challenges are time trials that require you to beat a certain time or beat opposing drivers in a specific number of laps.

Some racetracks only have one race challenge, while others have a few different ones that you'll unlock as you progressively beat each challenge. You'll also find that some racetracks call for different vehicles, as one track uses stock cars while another makes you drive off-road vehicles.

You can see each GTA 6 racetrack, its location, and the race challenges at the track below.

Gellhorn Raceway

The Gellhorn Raceway offers arguably the best racing experience in GTA 6, being a full stock car track that offers three different race challenges.

  • Race Challenges: Introduction, Raceway Trial, Dragway Trial
  • Location: South of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County. The Dragway Trial is located on the northern part of the track, and the Introduction/Raceway Trial are located in the middle part of the track.

Thrillbilly Mud Club

Located in the heart of Kelly County, the Thrillbilly Mud Club offers the most race challenges of any racetrack in GTA 6 (six challenges). There's a variety of challenges, some of which don't involve racing, and all of them take place on dirt and mud tracks, making for a wild experience.

  • Race Challenges: Air Time Stunt Run, Drag Trial, Dirt Track Trial, Hill Climb Trial, Oval Trial, Swamp Run Trial
  • Location: Just below the "North Kelly County" text on the map, northwest of Ambrosia

Boone Speedway

Boone Speedway isn't a huge racetrack, but it offers a unique race challenge where, every lap, the last-place driver is eliminated. This goes on until there is a single driver left standing. Drivers race on dirt using custom off-road vehicles. You can find the Boone Speedway in southwest Hamlet.

  • Race Challenges: Elimination Race
  • Location: Located in southwest Hamlet, found southeast of Grassrivers

Ambrosia Raceway

Ambrosia Raceway is an old-fashioned racetrack that consists of a dirt track, small grandstands, and a raceway trial that is more difficult than you might think.

  • Race Challenges: Raceway Trial
  • Location: Just north of Ambrosia, west of Lake Leonida

Waning Sands

Waning Sands offers an unnamed racetrack that has a motocross stunt run challenge, where you use a dirt bike and perform stunts over sandy dunes. Your goal is to score enough stunt points before the timer ends, which can be done by getting air and performing tricks, such as backflips.

  • Race Challenges: Motocross Stunt Run
  • Location: Just north of Waning Sands, east of Lake Leonida

Hamlet

There's no icon for this racetrack or challenge on the map, but if you visit north Hamlet, just south of the prison, you'll find a track with a BMX Stunt Run challenge. The track has dirt hills and custom ramps where you take a bike and try to earn enough stunt points before the timer runs out.

  • Race Challenges: BMX Stunt Run
  • Location: In north Hamlet, northeast of the Boone Speedway

Mount Kalaga

Finally, we arrive at Mount Kalaga, where there's not much going on aside from some hunting challenges and an airfield with a few planes. However, you can also find a cycling time trial, where you grab a bike and go down the mountain, hitting checkpoints until you reach the finish line. There's some serious air to grab down the mountain as well, making this one of the more enjoyable challenges.

  • Race Challenges: Cycling Trial
  • Location: Near the top of Mount Kalaga National Park, on the eastern side of the mountain

And those are all of the racetracks and race challenges you can currently find in GTA 6. While there are plenty more street races to partake in, these challenges offer the best overall racing experience in Leonida.

title: Best Cars To Get Early In GTA 6
summary:
During the first part of Grand Theft Auto 6, you have some looming responsibilities that the game clearly wants you to prioritize. Whether it's fixing up Jason's house in Key Lento or buying Lucia some presents for when she gets home, your main objectives are flooded with basic chores.

Naturally, though, this is GTA, so your real priorities might be staying out until all hours to make more money and find a fast car to drive. We've already covered the best ways to make early money in GTA 6, so now let's look at where to find great cars in the first half of the game.

In This Article
  • Best cars to buy early in GTA 6
    • Vapid Firebug Dominator
    • Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF
    • Canis Gunrunner Kamacho

Best cars to buy early in GTA 6

We're mainly specifying the first half of GTA 6 due to a couple of factors. First, you need to make it to the point in the story where you can register cars as your own, which takes until roughly the 30% completion mark. Second, you likely won't have lots of cash to spend on registering vehicles when you do unlock that ability. Expensive cars require tens of thousands of dollars to register, so you'll want to eye some cheaper cars near the beginning of the game.

Fortunately, just because a car doesn't cost $30K to register doesn't mean it's not worth going after in GTA 6. There are some high-quality cars you can find fairly early on that don't cost much to register and can be stolen without the use of a Key Cloner or other car-stealing tool.

Below, we'll run through a few of these cars and where to find them so you'll be set up perfectly for the second half of GTA 6.

Vapid Firebug Dominator

We're starting the list with a car that you can obtain right after receiving the ability to register cars with Moses in Port Gellhorn. The Vapid Firebug Dominator is a great early-game car with plenty of speed and performance that doesn't carry a hefty registration fee.

It's located in the La Cascara Motel parking lot right on the beach in western Port Gellhorn. This is home to a Kolt & Associates drug ring in GTA 6, but the enemies are easy to deal with. You could also sneak in and use a Slim Jim on the car to steal it quietly. Either way, the Vapid Firebug Dominator is a great first car to register in GTA 6, primarily due to its location and cheap registration fee.

  • Location: Kolt & Associates hideout on the beach in western Port Gellhorn
  • Registration Fee: $2,950

Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF

For this car, you're going to have to travel into the heart of Vice City. Even if you're still in Chapter 2, though, this car is worth going the extra mile for. It's called the Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF, but you might recognize it as an Easter egg referencing Paul Walker's Mitsubishi Eclipse from the original Fast & Furious film. The car looks nearly identical to its real-life counterpart, featuring the same paint job and style.

To steal this car, you have to travel to Vespucci Island, which is part of the Rialto Islands in central Vice City. Here, travel to a specific house on the island, hop the gate, and then break into the garage to find the Penumbra sitting there. You'll need to cut the security alarm on the garage wall, then steal the car, drive it out of the garage, and register it for a criminally low fee.

  • Location: Private house located in the center part of Vespucci Island inside the garage
  • Registration Fee: $6,750

Canis Gunrunner Kamacho

Our third and final recommended car is one you might not be expecting. It's called the Canis Gunrunner Kamacho, and it's located in western Vice-Dale County, near the VCIA Airport in GTA 6. This isn't a supercar or one that will do a great job of evading the police. However, if you're looking to make money with the car you drive, then this is the one you want.

The Canis Kamacho is a massive 4x4 pickup truck that comes in a variety of styles in GTA 6. The Gunrunner variant, which you can find at a "Robbery Opportunity" in Vice City, has a winch pre-installed on the back of it. The winch allows you to tow cars, boats, and other vehicles. More importantly, though, it lets you hook ATMs full of cash and tow them away so you can loot what's inside. Even ATMs attached to buildings can be towed, so the Gunrunner Kamacho will pay for itself in no time. It's also just a fun truck to drive, especially in Kelly County and around Mount Kalaga where the roads turn to dirt trails.

  • Location: Inside the garage of the "Leonida Carrier Warehouse" robbery location in western Vice-Dale County, specifically south of Balsero
  • Registration Fee: $6,700

And those are our picks for the three best early-game cars in GTA 6. They're not as luxurious as something like the legendary Progen Emerus supercar, but they can more than do the job as you build up cash for a major investment later on.

There’s so much more to learn and do in Leonida, so be sure to use our GTA 6 guides hub.

title: Just Like GTA 6, The Witcher 4 Has A PlayStation Deal
summary:
CD Projekt Red has announced that just today, November 24, the Polish studio signed new deals with Sony Interactive Entertainment for The Witcher 4's upcoming marketing campaign, among other efforts.

CFO Piotr Nielubowicz told investors that the deals cover CD Projekt Red's games on PlayStation and in the PlayStation Plus catalog, as well as "our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign."

“This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years," he said, according to VGC.

No specifics were made available, but the partnership for The Witcher 4's marketing campaign has people theorizing that it could be similar to Rockstar's co-marketing deal with Sony for GTA 6.

Under that agreement, GTA 6 was marketed as a game that "plays best on PS5," even if the jury is out on that being true. Sony also created special GTA 6 DualSense controllers and even custom consoles for NBA players. The PlayStation branding was prioritized over Xbox to give people the impression that they should get it on PlayStation.

The Witcher 4 is in the works now and is expected to launch in 2028 for console and PC. The game kicks off a new trilogy of The Witcher games, which will also include The Witcher 5 and The Witcher 6. These will all be released within a six-year window, so the whole new trilogy could be out by 2034.

The studio is “targeting” a 2028 release for The Witcher 4, so it could be delayed like The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 were before it.

title: Stop Kicking The Dogs In GTA 6–Buy Them Treats Instead
summary:
GTA 6 drops Jason and Lucia into a vast criminal world of rival gangs all across Leonida, and many of those gangs use guard dogs to help fend off trespassers. Inevitably, this has meant players are feeling forced to kick (or even shoot) the poor pups who were conscripted into a life of crime they never asked for. But don't worry; you don't have to hurt the dogs if you know their weakness: snacks.

As either Lucia or Jason, you can visit convenience stores all across the game and buy dog treats from the clerk. For $6, you'll get a 10-pack from any store that has them. You can find convenience stores by opening your map, heading to the Food & Drink section, and browsing by convenience stores. It'll show you all the ones you've discovered, arranged by distance from your current location.

Any dog in the game will gladly accept a treat, though they're especially helpful when a hostile dog is close to blowing your cover when you're sneaking around a gang hideout. To toss them a treat, use the left trigger to focus on them, then choose the option to throw one.

This will make the dog non-hostile for a short while--long enough to get past them without causing a scene. They'll eventually become hostile again, mind you, so you'll want to move or at least have another treat as backup. Still, it's better than hurting them.

It's a little frustrating that you can't see the number of dog treats in your inventory until you go to throw one, so you might end up in a situation with too few. You also need to ensure both Lucia and Jason have their own treats. Like anything else in the game that isn't their joint savings account, their treats aren't shared. I've taken to just buying some whenever I'm near a convenience store.

By the way, the same friendlier approach you can take with the dogs often works with other animals, too. Sharks, for example, don't usually need to be attacked--except for the first mission you do for Kenton when a shark can actually eat one of Kenton's customers if you're not quick to defend him.

Otherwise, sharks, gators, cougars, and other would-be-scary animals are more often just territorial, and if you back off and show them they don't need to worry about you, they'll leave you alone, too. Just think of them all as dogs you wouldn't want to kick.

title: Rip And Tear Into Doom: The Dark Ages’ Newest Game Mode For A Fraction Of The Price
summary:
Doom Slayer’s arsenal keeps growing, and so does his hatred of demons. After releasing the impressive Revelations expansion earlier this year, Doom: The Dark Ages is giving Doom Slayer, and by extension you, another chance to go on a gut-stomping, glorious rampage against the forces of Hell. The new Slaughter Mode is free for all existing DLC owners, and if you’ve been waiting to dive into this historic version of the ripping-and-tearing character, well, now’s the perfect opportunity.

For those unaware, Doom: The Dark Ages takes the typical formula of the iconic series, but straps a chainsaw-bladed shield to Doom Slayer’s gauntlet and gives you equally creative ways to dish out death. Set before the events of 2016’s pseudo-reboot and its sequel, Eternal, The Dark Ages sees Doom Slayer fighting a war under the control of the Maykrs, assisting the people of Argent D'Nur against Hell—specifically Prince Ahzrak.

Revelations, the post-launch expansion included with the Premium Edition (or available to buy separately), continues the story following the main narrative’s end. I won’t go into detail to avoid spoilers, but it’s a required purchase for the new Slaughter Mode. And, well, it’s also an excellent expansion on its own, so it’s well worth buying, too.

So, what does the new mode offer? Well, slaughter, of course. Exchanging the shield for the Chain Spear, Doom Slayer is a lot more mobile than in the main Dark Ages story mode, letting you whip around the arenas and use your entire arsenal while dashing and grappling around. It’s not Eternal levels of slickness, but it’s definitely more movement-oriented than the base game.

Every bullet, whether that’s pieces of demon skulls or a giant cannonball attached to a chain, is filled with enough hatred that every enemy feels satisfying to kill. It’s the Doom way, and Slaughter Mode amps that up with an endless experience that sees you earn rewards. If you manage to secure your currency, you can walk away with a chance to purchase some neat cosmetics. However, it’s just fun to rip and tear constantly without having to head into various levels.

If you want to give Doom: The Dark Ages’ new game mode a try, you can buy the entire experience so far for just $30.80 / £26.84 at Fanatical, netting you the Premium Edition—which includes the base game, the Revelations DLC, and some extra digital goodies. That’s a BFD—a big flipping discount worth getting while it’s still available.

Rip and tear, my friends, rip and tear.

title: WoW: Forever’s Best Buffs Now Work As Intended
summary:
World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made World Buffs persist across loading screens as intended.

World Buffs are powerful stat-boosting effects granted to players in a particular area for certain events. The most common World Buff players see is Warchief's Blessing on the Horde and the new Might of Stormwind for the Alliance, which are granted to all players in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and their surrounding low-level zones when players on their respective faction turn in a specific high-level quest.

Now that players are reaching endgame and turning in the required quest, these buffs are popping off constantly. They grant a whopping 300 hit points, 15% melee haste, and 10 mana regen per five seconds for one hour. At lower levels, those are some serious stats, particularly the 300 HP.

Unfortunately, players haven't been able to take full advantage of the buffs, as a bug was causing them to be lost when hitting a loading screen. That meant any time a group stepped into a dungeon or took a boat or zeppelin to a new location, their World Buffs would be removed.

That has finally been fixed in the latest update, so players can now enter dungeons with World Buffs to help maximize their damage and health. This should be particularly useful for doing dungeons at a slightly lower level than is intended, as the extra HP and melee haste is definitely noticable.

Blizzard clarified in the patch notes that World Buffs will still be removed when entering raids, so players won't be able to stack as many World Buffs as possible before raid night, as was the case in previous versions of classic WoW. 

Other changes found in the patch notes include a fix for an Uldaman boss that players were exploiting to make fast gold. Another is a fix for "a few spells and abilities" that were causing more weapon-proc effects than intended, likely nerfing the DPS of whatever classes were taking advantage of the bug. You can read the full patch notes below.

Blizzard recently outlined in the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast how it wants to get rid of the idea of "best-in-slot gear," as well as how the game's has overhauled old-school WoW's player-vs.-player systems. In other Forever news, the game's launch has seen more than 15 million characters created so far, with the highest weekly player numbers for WoW in 15 years. 

WoW: Forever November 23 Hotfix Patch Notes

Classes

  • Druid
    • The 4-piece Feralheart set for Druids now correctly grants 4 Energy regeneration every 1 second for 5 seconds.
  • Priest
    • Mind Vision should no longer proc effects.
    • Shadow
      • Fixed an issue where Dark Inspiration was not granting the correct amount of %Spirit increase if Mind Flay was used to activate it.
      • Fixed an issue where Chastise was not usable in Shadowform.
  • Warlock
    • Destruction
      • Fixed an issue where Intensity was not working on Incinerate.
  • Warrior
    • Fixed an issue where players could have and use Mortal Strike from their spellbook, even without the Mortal Strike talent. This does not remove it from their spellbook but prevents it from being used without the talent point spent.

Dungeons

  • Uldaman
    • The Obsidian Sentinel drops loot as intended.

Items

  • The Filcher’s Cowl no longer has a level requirement.

Professions

  • Cooking
    • Boiled Clams, Clam Chowder, Goblin Deviled Clams, Giant Clam Scorcho, Undermine Clam Chowder, and Clam Linguine each now offer the correct Well Fed bonuses and have been recategorized in the recipe list under “Stamina Food”.
    • Murloc Fin Soup has had its recovery and Well-Fed amounts increased to the next tier of food, bringing it closer to other food of that level.
  • Engineering
    • Fixed a bug that caused Goblin Engineer’s Renewal Gift and Gnome Engineer’s Renewal Gift to appear as broken, unusable question marks in the inventory.
    • Fixed a bug that prevented “The Mortar: Reloaded” recipe from being learned upon learning the “Goblin Mortar” recipe.
  • Leatherworking
    • Fixed a bug that prevented Pattern: Centaur Hoofwarmers from being learnable.

Quests

  • Riverglades - Dunston Willis once again runs near the end of the escort “Dunston Checks Out.”
  • Wetlands - After further study, the quest “For Further Study” now has rewards.
  • Wetlands - The quest “Uncovering the Past” now rewards Ironforge reputation.
  • Wetlands - The quest “Gleaning Our Future” now rewards Ironforge reputation.

Races

  • Fixed an issue where Wisp Form could be applied to players while they were alive.

Spells

  • Fixed an issue where a few spells and abilities were causing more weapon procs than intended.
  • Fixed an issue where World Buffs would fall off when changing areas. They will still fall off when entering raid instances.
  • Fixed an issue where Fengus’ Ferocity was granting twice as much Spell Power as intended.
  • Fixed an issue where Darkmoon Faire buffs were granting twice as much power as intended.

title: Witcher 4 Has Fewer People Working On It Than It Did 3 Months Ago, But Just Barely
summary:
As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, the Polish developer revealed new information about its projects and headcount.

For the quarter that ended on October 31, The Witcher 4 was the company's biggest project by headcount, with 513 people working on it. That's down from 519 people for the quarter that ended on July 31.

For comparison, the number of developers on Cyberpunk 2 rose from 184 to 199 and staffers on the new IP codenamed Hadar jumped from 33 to 34. The codename Sirius game, believed to be a multiplayer The Witcher game, saw its development staff shrink from 84 to 60; the project has undergone numerous shifts throughout its development as CD Projekt reworks the experience.

CD Projekt's total development headcount rose from 1,045 to 1,051.

In terms of money, CD Projekt reported Q3 revenue of 208 million PLN ($51 million USD) and net earnings of 109 million PLN ($26.8 million). CD Projekt spent a lot--more than 177 million PLN ($43.5 million) on development costs during the quarter--but the company's total cash reserves grew by 31 million PLN ($7.6 million USD).

CD Projekt has a number of big projects in the works, including The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in 2027 and The Witcher 4 in 2028. Cyberpunk 2 is also on the way, but it doesn't have a release window yet. The company is also working on a game with Scopely, the mobile gaming giant owned by Saudi Arabia.

Cyberpunk 2 was in the news recently, as the game's creative director joked that the RPG is now canceled because GTA 6 is so good.

In terms of money, CD Projekt reported Q3 revenue of 208 million PLN ($51 million USD) and net earnings of 109 million PLN ($26.8 million). CD Projekt spent a lot--more than 177 million PLN ($43.5 million) on development costs during the quarter--but the company's total cash reserves grew by 31 million PLN ($7.6 million USD).

CD Projekt has a number of big projects in the works, including The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in 2027 and The Witcher 4 in 2028. Cyberpunk 2 is also on the way, but it doesn't have a release window yet. The company is also working on a game with Scopely, the mobile gaming giant owned by Saudi Arabia.

Cyberpunk 2 was in the news recently, as the game's creative director joked that the RPG is now canceled because GTA 6 is so good.

title: GTA 6 Is Giving Pornhub A Hard Time
summary:
Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen a decline in viewership since the massive open-world game launched. It's not surprising, given the game's record-breaking start, with 32.5 million sales from preorders alone. On PS5, GTA 6 is the "biggest launch" in PlayStation history, and players spent an average of 17.4 hours playing in its first few days--which probably didn't leave much time for a quick browse of after-hours material.

According to Mashable, US traffic on Pornhub--which I've been told is one of the largest pornography websites, by traffic--dipped by as much as 15.5% an hour after GTA 6 launched. Paradoxically, Pornhub traffic had actually been up by 16.5% compared to average days, likely indicating that people were bored and randy. Pornhub traffic started to fluctuate after the GTA 6 launch and reached an average peak a few days later.

Thanks to the game's massive success, we're also seeing the Rule 34 effect on GTA 6, as Mashable's research noted a 16,196% spike in GTA-related searches. Up to 15 million search queries were made on November 18 alone, with users searching for GTA 6, the GTA 6 strip club, and content depicting the co-protagonist Lucia specifically. The fan-favorite stalker--and possible serial killer--Mandy also appeared in search results, while Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason ranked low.

Thursday Night Football also saw a big dip last week, with the lowest viewership of the season so far for a TNF game. While Rockstar's new open-world adventure can't be blamed entirely for that dip, it certainly must have had an impact, given that the football game was held on GTA 6's launch day. That effect didn't extend to the box office, as The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to a massive $120 million in the US, almost triple that of the last film in the series, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.
